answer: Because the delta nonce is published only after close, the grove audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. The three words are derived from a 95 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate ember derivation per key. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
